## Check these first

Some things are settled and will be declined regardless of how well argued. This
is not a judgement about your idea; it is that the project has a small number of
properties worth protecting.

- [ ] It needs no network access. Anything requiring `INTERNET` is rejected
      outright: `requirement.md` section 8
- [ ] It is not accounts, login, or cloud sync
- [ ] It is not sleep tracking, health integration, or wellness scoring
- [ ] It is not social, sharing, or leaderboards
- [ ] It is not screen-time blocking or app-locking. Different product, different
      ethics
- [ ] It makes no medical claim
- [ ] It does not require showing the user something they did not ask for

`requirement.md` section 12 has the full out-of-scope list, and section 11 has the
roadmap in case it is already planned.

## Would it fit the ideology

Horizon has no paid tier, no advertising, and no telemetry, so a feature cannot
be justified by engagement, retention, or growth. The question is only whether it
makes the app better for someone using it in a dark room at 1 a.m.
